stem_book: A particle is suspended from a fixed point by a string of length 5 m. It is projected from the equilibrium position with such a velocity that the string slackens after the particle has reached a height 8 m above the lowest point. The height to which the particle can rise further in cm, is 24x. Find x.
work: v² = 30 at slack, velocity ⊥ string, vertical component = v cosφ (cosφ = 0.8); rise = 30·0.64/20 = 0.96 m = 96 cm = 24·4
